extras: Free, local-first, no cloud, no account, no subscription.
intentEvidence: Obsidian Sync costs $4/month and sends your vault through Obsidian's cloud. Obsync is an alternative that keeps your notes on your devices
motivation: To provide a free, private, and local-first alternative to Obsidian Sync that keeps vault data on the user's devices.
problem: Obsidian Sync requires a paid subscription and relies on a third-party cloud service, which users may wish to avoid for privacy or cost reasons.

relations.evidence: Obsync is an alternative that keeps your notes on your devices
Obsync core (Rust) — the sync engine, httpd dashboard, and Android app this plugin's engine is ported from.

summary: A local-first P2P synchronization tool that allows users to sync their Obsidian vault directly between devices over a local network without using cloud services or accounts.
